name: @helpdesk/gateway-core
description: The shared spine every gateway is built from (SPRINT3.md, 3.2): HTTP transport, MCP server wiring, token validation, the validate/decide/audit/branch call order, and the refusal shapes. Carries no policy rules, no tool schemas, and no credential of its own — a gateway with neither is a first-class case, not a workaround, because the knowledge gateway (SPRINT3.md, 3.3) needs exactly that.

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/handoff-core build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/handoff-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/handoff-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
